test_case.test_name: Variant-bound Type-C hub to VGA/HDMI physical display and visible-image validation
test_case.purpose: Verify the approved Type-C display path, hub and VGA/HDMI monitor render a stable, readable known pattern at the required mode without blanking, flicker, artifacts, color/orientation error or display/system faults.
required_package: Source Key/Variant identity and exclusion of same-code Reserve SEL
SUT Type-C receptacle, controller/mux/retimer and GPU/BMC/DPoC display-source path
Approved Type-C hub PN/firmware/power, selected VGA/HDMI output, cable/adapter and monitor EDID
Required resolution/refresh/color/orientation and known-pattern visual rubric
Signed connection/removal procedure, error limits and operator recovery
test_case.test_command: A qualified operator verifies the exact variant and fixture, inspects connectors/power, connects the approved Type-C hub and selected VGA/HDMI monitor once using the signed sequence, displays the approved known pattern, records mode/EDID where available and timestamped photos/video, and observes readability, stability, blanking, flicker, artifacts, color and orientation. Preserve display/BMC/kernel events and remove or leave the setup only as specified.
test_case.expected_result: The exact display source reaches the approved monitor through the mapped Type-C hub/output, the required mode is active, the known pattern is visibly correct and stable for the signed observation interval, and no prohibited display, BMC, kernel or physical anomaly occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when composite identity, full path and fixture, required mode, real known-pattern visual evidence and signed stability/artifact/error rubric all match. Blank/no signal, wrong source/mode, unreadable or unstable image, flicker/artifact/color/orientation error, heat or new display/system error is FAIL. Missing path/fixture/rubric is BLOCKED at execution; EDID or connector status alone cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until Source Key/Variant, display-source path, fixture, mode/rubric and hot-plug/power procedure are signed.
Operator owns physical connection and direct visual observation; inspect compatibility and never force connectors.
No same-code SEL command, display-setting change, log clearing, repeated reconnect, automatic retry or recovery.
Stop on resistance, damage, abnormal heat, unstable/lost image, artifacts/flicker or new display/system errors.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and explicit separation from row 1195 Reserve SEL
Approved connection procedure plus before/connected/final photos
EDID and selected resolution/refresh/color/orientation where available
Preserved display/BMC/kernel errors, safe removal/final state and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On resistance, heat, link instability, blanking or image/system error, stop and preserve evidence. The operator disconnects only through the signed sequence and restores the prior physical display state; do not force, reconnect repeatedly, alter SEL/display settings or retry automatically.
